subject.title: lossless-claw bootstraps into quarantine after every Gateway restart due to new sessionId generating fresh JSONL file

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as the opt-in contract for preserving aborted main-session ids across controlled Gateway restarts, or should this wait for a broader restart-recovery design?
rationale: The source-level gap is credible and the linked PR is proof-backed, but the proposed fix adds a compatibility-sensitive session config surface and changes session-state reuse semantics that AGENTS.md and VISION.md treat as maintainer-level product and upgrade decisions.

options.title: Sponsor the linked opt-in
options.body: Proceed with reviewing and landing the linked PR if maintainers accept an explicit `session.restartContinuation` knob for this narrow Gateway restart continuity case.

options.title: Require config-free recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open but redirect the fix toward a generic restart-recovery mechanism that avoids a new session config knob.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR if maintainers decide OpenClaw should not preserve aborted session ids across restarts for this lossless-claw workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the linked opt-in
recommendation.body: Proceed with reviewing and landing the linked PR if maintainers accept an explicit `session.restartContinuation` knob for this narrow Gateway restart continuity case.
